quotes.author: Kirsten K.
quotes.text: We had a great experience on the Alligator tour with Anthony. The boat was nice and quiet so we could enjoy the scenery. Anthony was very knowledgeable and helpful. We saw lots of alligators of all ages and sizes. And the preserve was beautiful. Great way to get away from the crowds and enjoy the wildlife.

quotes.author: Glenn B.
quotes.text: Had an amazing day on the water with my wife, daughter and her boyfriend yesterday in Hilton Head. The staff is friendly and very professional. Great experience when vacationing in Hilton Head. I would recommend H2O Sports to all my friends and family.

quotes.author: Molly M.
quotes.text: Amazing time on our dolphin tour with Captain Freddy! So very knowledgeable, along with being very personable. We saw a ton of dolphins, as well as learned so very much about the area. Don't miss this experience with Captain Freddy; he is exceptional!

quotes.author: Ruthie T.
quotes.text: Awesome alligator tour in Sea Pines preserve. Anthony our tour guide was so knowledgeable and fun. Our family really enjoyed the tour, seeing the alligators and wildlife in the preserve. It was recommended by all my friends and did not disappoint.

quotes.author: Leigh P.
quotes.text: Great time! Captain Mike was wonderful! Very knowledgeable and clearly loves what he does. Knew just where to look for the alligators. Provided lots of info on the native species. So glad we did this! Would definitely do it again.

quotes.author: Fel S.
quotes.text: Captain Frank took good care of us from Harbour Town dock to Daufuskie dock. It was threatening rain so he gave us good tip to see the island in a few hours. Had a great tour on our own. Highly recommend H2O sports!

We went for a dolphin tour with H2O sports. Had a great experience. We were just two families there. Small boat no crowd. Saw many dolphins got lucky I guess. Captain Freddy is very engaging fun and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend this for families.

Captain Frank is the king. I cannot even count how many dolphins we encountered. Perfect smaller size boat (like 8-10 people) with easy open viewing. Just the ride into the marsh areas was worth the price of admission.
